visual.description: Donut chart with two segments: Synthetic 69% (Accent Pink) and Natural 31% (Accent Blue). Segments sweep clockwise with spring animation. Center label: '69%' in JetBrains Mono large. Title: 'Global Textile Production' top-left. Legend below chart. Source text bottom-right in Inter muted. 67% of 4,000+ fast fashion products contained synthetic fibers — small annotation.
visual.sourceText: Source: Changing Markets Foundation, Synthetics Anonymous

notes: Simple two-slice donut — visually clean. The 69% dominance should feel overwhelming. Keep it minimal — just two colors per brand guide rules.
